note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after 0411b53e91). RFC 7432 Section 8.2.1: "If All-Active redundancy mode is desired, then the "Single-Active" bit in the flags of the ESI Label extended community MUST be set to 0 and the MPLS label in that Extended Community MUST be set to a valid MPLS label value." Stale only because 0411b53e91 replaced the redundancy-mode argument with a routeIntent struct (redundancyMode plus overlayIndex) through parseL2VPNArgs, l2vpnRouteToEVPNParams, parseConfigRoute and EncodeRoute; the new overlay-index guard refuses only a named selector on a non-ip-prefix route and never touches the Ethernet A-D path. The tagged test units did not change. Both clauses stay proven as before (flag and valid-label refusals with exact text, flag-0 bytes and labels 16/1048575 accepted). Fresh overlay mutants (tags ze_core ze_bgp): parseConfigRoute passing an intent without the mode reddens TestConfiguredEVPNRefusesPerESRedundancyMismatch; EncodeRoute passing an intent without the mode reddens TestOriginPerESRedundancyModeRefused; l2vpnRouteToEVPNParams dropping intent.redundancyMode reddens both; parseL2VPNArgs mapping single-active to all-active reddens TestOriginPerESRedundancyModeAccepted, TestOriginPerESRedundancyModeRefused and TestConfiguredEVPNRefusesPerESRedundancyMismatch. The message-package tests (TestRFC7432ESILabelRedundancyAccepted/Refused) are untouched by the change. Earlier open item unchanged: the config-path positive is only the untagged test/encode/evpn-per-es-redundancy-mode.ci, and the bgp-evpn-gobgp interop still owes its red proof.
